Description: Permissions policy for federated users with user-specific data isolation

Notes.UserIsolation: Uses ${aws:userid} policy variable to isolate user data

PolicyVariables.aws:userid: Unique identifier for the assumed role session (AROAID:session-name)

BestPractices: Use least privilege - grant only necessary permissions
Implement data isolation using policy variables
Use resource-based policies for additional security
Regular audit of permissions and access patterns
